text_block_list.text:
One day, Hishi Miracle was reading
a fan letter that had arrived for her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness.
I actually passed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They said they passed the exam!
Actually, I met the person who wrote this letter
in town just a little while ago.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, you're Hishi Miracle-san, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm a big fan of yours!
I always watch your races!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much!
Huh, really? It's not like my running
is particularly flashy or anything...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all! Seeing you run, Hishi Miracle, gave me so much courage!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Just recently, too. I had a certification exam coming up...
but I had zero motivation, and it was really troubling me...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"That was when I saw Hishi Miracle-san's race!
Seeing her stubbornly refuse to give up and the sheer
determination on her face at the wire gave me so much courage!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Courage... from my running?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, wow. I'm so, so happy.
Waaah... thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, good luck on your exam!
I'll do my best in my race too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...and so that happened. Then, that person sent me a letter to let me know they passed the exam!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Getting reports like this really makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: “They told me seeing me work hard inspired them to stick to their diet, or win an award in an art contest.”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
People often tell me that...
It really makes me feel like I have to do my best, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It feels like my fans and I are
cheering each other on and doing our best together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even if I only have ordinary power on my own,
everyone's feelings make me strong...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, for everyone's sake,
I'll have to try even harder!

Receiving fan letters filled
Hishi Miracle with motivation.
